issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 08 uses a wildcard SELECT (SELECT *) returning all columns (solution_repository/aufgabe08.sql lines 1-3), but the problem statement explicitly requires only the specific columns: Name, Landkreis, Fläche and the Einwohnerzahlen. The general instruction in the problem statement ('Gib immer genau die geforderten Daten aus und nicht mehr.') means the autograder expects exactly those columns; using SELECT * in the reference solution is inconsistent and will confuse students about which columns are required and may cause automated column-checks to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Update solution_repository/aufgabe08.sql to select exactly the requested columns instead of using SELECT *. For example: SELECT name, kreis, flaeche, einwohner_m, einwohner_w FROM Gemeinde WHERE (einwohner_m > 50000 AND einwohner_w > 50000) OR flaeche > 100; This ensures the reference solution matches the problem instructions and the autograder's column checks.
